title: feat(objectql)!: by-name readers of apps, pages, dashboards, reports, books, cubes, tools, skills and agents consult (package, name)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9YGpy1NJdhGQFV6brdHkrTP)_

Fixes #31680

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc teaches a bare read of a name two packages ship, an environment item read by a package caller, or a read of an undeclared package's item; ADR-0150 D3 already states the rule, and the `?package=` qualifier the refusals point to is already documented on the meta read.
Narrowing: (1) a bare name two packages ship, read with no package, is refused naming both (first-party count 0; for agent, skill and tool only on a deployment that booted already holding the clash); (2) a package caller's name only the environment holds is refused, D3 (a) (count 0); (3) a package caller's name whose one holder is outside its declared closure is refused (count 0, same-artifact siblings 0).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：应用、页面、仪表盘、报表、手册、分析立方体、工具、技能和智能体这九类元数据，按名字读取时统一走 R 的那一个包内解析器（ADR-0150 D3），不再由注册表"谁先注册就给谁"。
- 为什么改：两个包发布同名页面时，不带包名的读取一直悄悄返回先注册的那个；包内调用方还能读到它没声明依赖的包或环境自有的条目。
- 收窄的三种情况一律返回 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT 并列出全部持有者；只有一个持有者或没有持有者时，行为与之前完全一样。仓库内四个示例应用触发次数均为 0。
- 风险与回滚：只改读取路径（getApp、MetadataFacade、协议的不带包名读取），不改任何存储形状、schema 或 MCP 输入输出；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`，然后 `registry.ts` 的 `resolveItem`，再看 `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 中的 `packagelessScopedRead`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位做合同审查，史诗席位做红线审查后落地。

## What changes

Child E8 of epic #31527 wires the by-name readers of nine types (`app`, `page`, `dashboard`, `report`, `book`, `analytics_cube`, `tool`, `skill`, `agent`) to R's one resolver, `resolvePackageScopedName` (the lean core R2 #31733 landed). This follows the epic seat's ruling (option A): both arms of `getApp` and `MetadataFacade`, and no bindable reader.

- **`package-scoped-read.ts` (new).** `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` lists the nine types. `readPackageScopedItem` turns the resolver's answer into a reader's: resolved returns the item, not-found returns `undefined`, and a refusal throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`. That error carries `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, `status`/`httpStatus: 409`, the resolver's own sentence naming every candidate, and the `refusal`. It restates no part of the rule and holds no closure walk of its own.
- **`SchemaRegistry.resolveItem(type, name, callerPackageId?, member?)` and `readsByPackage(type)`.** A wired type is read through `readPackageScopedItem`; every other type keeps `getItem`.

The readers, and the caller package each one passes:

| Reader | Caller package passed |
|---|---|
| `SchemaRegistry.getApp(name, currentPackageId?)` | `currentPackageId` |
| `MetadataFacade.get(type, name, currentPackageId?)` | `currentPackageId` |
| `MetadataFacade.getEntry(type, name)` | none |
| `MetadataFacade.exists(type, name)` | none; a refusal answers `true` (the holders exist) |
| protocol `readMetaItem` with no `packageId` (`GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME`, both faces, so MCP `agent_prompt` too) | `null` (a caller with no package) |

- **Protocol read.** The package-less arm calls `registry.resolveItem(type, name, null, member)` once, before any layer is read, and step 3 serves that answer in place of `getItem` and its plural retry. A read with `?package=` keeps `getItem`; that address is G1's exact qualifier, not a caller. metadata-protocol still cannot import objectql, so it reaches the resolver only through the registry's `resolveItem`. No new import edge.
- **MCP.** No code change and no input or output shape change (that is G2's). `agent_prompt` already reads through the protocol read (#31514). One new pin: a 409 refusal travels as a protocol error naming both holders. It is never answered as "not found" or as the outage text.
- Barrel exports: the four names and the type from `@objectstack/objectql`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` (new, 71 tests). It runs the real `SchemaRegistry`, the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and the real `MetadataFacade`, and covers:
  - the type list;
  - the 409 mapping through `resolveThrownHttpError`;
  - narrowing (1) for each of the six types phase 1 does not cover (app, page, dashboard, report, book, analytics cube), at both protocol faces, `facade.get`/`getEntry` and `getApp`;
  - narrowings (2) and (3) for all nine types;
  - the CONTROL for all nine types: one holder, the environment's item, zero holders not-found, the `?package=` read untouched, and getApp's nav contributions;
  - a non-wired type keeps `getItem`.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.agent-prompt-advertised.test.ts`: one new test, the refusal travels.
- **Forced test edit, one:** `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` (#30803 / #31414, phase 1). Its cold boot holds an agent, skill and tool clash between two packages (a boot warns, it does not refuse), and it pinned that `GET /meta/agent|tool/NAME` with no package "keeps serving the first-registered package's item". That is narrowing (1) on the wire, and the full dogfood battery went red on exactly those 3 tests (3 failed / 3659 passed) on head 9e37aefb. The pin now asserts `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both packages for agent, skill and tool, and that `?package=` serves each package's own. The boot warning, the install refusals and the skill-prompt reading are unchanged.

**Red on main** (b126c130, the probe in the card notes): for every uncovered type, with two holders, `/meta`, `facade.get` and `getApp` with no package served `alpha`, the first registered. A package caller was served an outside-closure single holder and an environment-only item. Before the wiring, the new file ran 25 failed and 48 passed; the 25 failures were exactly the three narrowing arms.

**Ablations.** Each mutation was put in through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and its run went red. Each was then restored, with the blob back to HEAD.

| # | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | `readsByPackage` → false (the protocol arm off) | 6 failed |
| A2 | `facade.get` → `getItem` | 24 failed |
| A3 | `getApp` → `getItem` | 3 failed |
| A4 | `resolveItem` → `getItem` | 24 failed |
| A5 | `exists` refusal → false | 1 failed |
| A6 | MCP `readAgentByName` reads `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` as a miss | 1 failed |
| A7 | protocol source arm disabled, metadata-protocol rebuilt | 6 failed; `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in dist |

For A7, the restore leg rebuilt metadata-protocol, the preflight found the marker absent from dist with the tree clean, and the run went back to 71/71.

## Acceptance notes

The four readings:

- **(a) The phase-1 one-holder tests stay green.** These ran green on the final head with no edit: `registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts`, `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`, `core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts`, `registry-cross-package-collision.test.ts`, `engine-cross-package-collision.test.ts`, and the full objectql suite. The one exception is the dogfood boot-clash pin named above: its "first registered is served" line is the behaviour E8 removes, so it is flipped. Its boot warning and install refusals are untouched.
- **(b) One-holder bare-name behaviour is unchanged except for the declared narrowings.** The CONTROL block pins it for all nine types at every rewired reader. Agent, skill and tool are phase-1 covered: a new install of a held name is refused, so narrowing (1) reaches them only on a deployment that booted already holding the clash.
- **(c) Migration.** None. This changes only what a read answers; no stored row, schema or shape changes (the `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker).
- **(d)** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, per seat 2's ruling. The changeset carries the BREAKING banner, with FROM→TO and the one-line fix.

Red lines:

- ONE resolver: every wired reader goes through `readPackageScopedItem` → `resolvePackageScopedName`. No reader walks a closure or falls back to the first composite.
- Ambiguity refuses, naming every candidate; zero holders stays not-found.
- `package-scoped-resolver.ts` was not edited.
- No `packages/spec/**`, `ui/**`, `docs/adr/**` or E6 readers were touched, and `registry.ts installPackage` was not touched.

By-name reads not rewired here. Each keeps `getItem`:

- the layered read (`getMetaItemLayered`);
- `readCodeLayerForCarryForward`;
- `protocol-artifact-lookup.ts`;
- the write side (`protocol-save.ts`, `protocol-authoring-gate.ts`);
- MCP's `diagnosedGet` for a host without a protocol;
- `getAppNavContributions`;
- the `getAllApps` list.

The seat can file any of these as later cards.

ADR-0146 overrides: a pair's stored override row is hydrated into the registry's bare slot (`protocol-registry-hydration.ts`), so a package-less read still finds the environment's item first, and the full ADR-0146 suites are green.

New public names, which are the seat's call: `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, `PackageScopedReadType`, `isPackageScopedReadType`, `readPackageScopedItem`, `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem` and `SchemaRegistry.readsByPackage`.

## Verification

Head `d981cf7c1ce46776fafe4b725f2a3ef9c77dec9e`, which merges origin/main fdfcc7ab. Every run below is on that head, under `os-verify-lock`, and each VERDICT was command-exit 0.

- Full `pnpm build`: green.
- Tests: objectql 22610 passed (29 skipped), metadata-protocol 980 passed, mcp 11887 passed.
- typecheck: clean for all three packages.
- Lint: eslint is clean on the three packages' `src` and on the edited dogfood file.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` listed 75 commands. All 75 exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles 75 derived, 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`): Test Files 441 passed, 3 skipped (444). Tests 3662 passed, 42 skipped (3704). 0 failed.
